text.formatted: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned for 8 hours. The poisoned creature is Unconscious. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
text.plain: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned for 8 hours. The poisoned creature is Unconscious. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
